text: {"status":"answered","answer":"For a domestic wire to another bank, it must be received and verified by 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a business day to be processed that same day; anything after that cutoff (or on a non-business day) goes out the next business day. This is under the Wire Transfer Policy, Rev 2026-02, for retail accounts. (Note: international wires have an earlier cutoff of 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.)","cited_chunk_ids":["wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Wire Transfer Policy directly states the same-day processing cutoff times for domestic and international wires for retail accounts."}
